description: SIMCom SIM7500/SIM7600 MBIM composition 1e0e:9003 (Linux 6.12 option.c: 'Simcom SIM7500/SIM7600 MBIM mode', vendor-class ttys only). As for 9001 the model comes from AT+CGMM, never from the PID. Interface numbers not known to us: no AT interface declared, ModemManager's SIMCom plugin finds its ports. netifd-mbim as the fallback, as on the other MBIM compositions; another modem manager 3.5.8 reads it with its 1e0e:9001 profile. Reference only, no bench of ours; profiles audit 2026-10-19

radio.source: another modem manager 3.5.5 1e0e9001 band profile (AT+CNMP, AT+CNBP, AT+CSYSSEL) and quirks.sh (SIM7600E-H LE11B11SIM7600M22: one slot, raw-text USSD answered); docs/modem-zoo/modems/simcom-sim7x.md (CPSI layout per RAT); SIMCom SIM7500/SIM7600 AT command manual
